open_points.subject: bootstrap_first_administrator
open_points.text: - bootstrap_first_administrator: [RETURN_SHAPE] MUST return the hash-free = models.StaffAccountView the imported build_staff_account_view builds from the account it handed to the port, so the password hash never leaves this module.
open_points.other_text: - bootstrap_first_administrator: [ORCHESTRATION] MUST normalize the supplied email and validate the supplied password through the existing staff identity input boundary, hash that password exactly as supplied with hash_password of the credential boundary, build the account with the imported build_bootstrap_staff_account from the normalized email, that hash and the one utc_now instant, build its audit record with the imported build_bootstrap_audit_record from that same instant and the built account, and hand both to the port in one call. It MUST NOT open a transaction, query persistence, or perform an authorization check, because no authorized administrator can exist yet.
open_points.question: Must the claim become that the password hash never enters the returned StaffAccountView, or must the account containing the hash no longer be handed to the port?

open_points.subject: bootstrap_first_administrator
open_points.text: - bootstrap_first_administrator: [FIELD_ASSIGNMENT] MUST pass to both builders as now one offset-naive UTC instant compatible with the existing persisted datetime model, and MUST NOT take any account or audit value from a caller argument other than the supplied email and password.
open_points.question: The passage must use [ORCHESTRATION], because it governs arguments passed to imported builders rather than assignment or population of a concrete field.
